title: Task G pilot maps
summary: The 2,000-voxel pilot region reconstructed five times with the same BFS seed order: the stored pilot (2026-10-10), the same configuration on today's code (the like-for-like baseline: the centroid screen became the default on 2026-10-12), SmoothCostRank E3+E4 tau 0.25 alone (Task G3), OutwardSearch alone, and both (Task G2's integrated configuration). Wrong voxels (more than 1 degree from the truth, of 2,000): stored pilot (2026-10-10): 37; stored configuration, today's code: 37; SmoothCostRank only: 34; OutwardSearch only: 36; both (Task G2's integrated configuration): 42. Grains lost (of 60): stored pilot (2026-10-10): 0; stored configuration, today's code: 0; SmoothCostRank only: 0; OutwardSearch only: 1; both (Task G2's integrated configuration): 1.
